page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-48 is an x86_64 general-purpose instance designed for balanced compute and memory operations. The machine provides 48 dedicated vCPUs and 186.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 3.88 GB of RAM per dedicated thread. The instance does not feature dedicated GPU accelerators.

Storage operations rely entirely on remote network-attached persistent storage, as the instance provision includes no local NVMe drives. In terms of network configuration, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned directly to the instance, requiring external network configurations or gateway routing for outbound public connectivity.

The hardware balance makes the instance cost-efficient for scaled, multi-threaded systems that do not mandate high-frequency burst mechanisms or specialized memory-heavy footprints. The instance fits container orchestration nodes, multi-threaded CI/CD builds, large enterprise web backend services, and distributed ETL batch workloads.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-48 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture. The configuration supplies 48 dedicated vCPUs and 186.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard balanced allocation of 3.88 GB per vCPU. The instance does not incorporate dedicated GPU acceleration and provides no local NVMe storage, relying on external network-attached storage volumes for operating system and data requirements. Additionally, the instance provisions no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Because of its steady allocation of dedicated processing threads and memory capacity, the c4d-standard-48 serves continuous enterprise workloads including container worker nodes, distributed data processing, enterprise web applications, and multi-threaded compilation pipelines.
